Subject: Partner Center referral: Contoso (Azure) — Referral ID AZ-99873

Hi Mina,

Microsoft Partner Center has routed a referral for Contoso to Redwood Inference. Primary details below — please confirm ownership and the field seller assignment so we can enable co-sell engagement. Attachment includes account match candidates and recent Azure subscription IDs.

Account: Contoso
Region: US
Estimated ARR: $120k
Referral ID: AZ-99873
Attachments: contoso_account_matrix.csv (CSV, 42KB)

Next steps suggested by Partner Center:
- Confirm Redwood owner for this referral within 48 hours
- Provide primary field seller contact (name + email) for co-sell activation
- Share intake form / onboarding packet back for marketplace listing sync

Let us know if you need assistance with the workflow. We will attempt to reach the field seller if provided.

Thanks,
PC Referrals Team
Microsoft Partner Center

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: pc-referrals@microsoft.com, Sarah Meyers <sarah.meyers@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-06-20 15:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral: Contoso (Azure) — Referral ID AZ-99873

Team — forwarding the Partner Center referral. Quick take below, then asks.

Key notes from the matrix: Contoso has three active subscriptions; one looks like an enterprise MSP-managed environment (subscription ID X-44). They flagged potential ownership collision with an existing trial lead from Q1 (HubSpot HS-2274) that Ben owns.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: can you confirm whether HS-2274 is the same Contoso legal entity? If yes, we should reconcile owner and avoid double-claiming. (See attached CSV)
- Vanessa: I need a recommended field seller to pass back to Microsoft for co-sell activation. Prefer someone with established Azure pre-sales for Contoso (they use AKS + Synapse).
- Karthik: please prepare the Redwood intake packet (two-pager + vendor consent) and drop on Drive link; I attached our standard intake PDF for quick review.

I will acknowledge Partner Center to confirm we've received and will provide owner + seller within 24 hours. If anyone thinks we should decline routing (conflict / competing internal lead), flag now.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_participant_intake.pdf

- Proposed field seller for Microsoft co-sell: Jordan Blake (Azure Enterprise Specialist) — contact jordan_blake@redwood.ai. He has worked Contoso pre-sales in 2026 and is available for a 30-min sync next week.
- We're returning the intake packet and permission form (attached) for execution; once signed we can flip co-sell on in Partner Center.

Ben / Karthik — Ben, please confirm whether HS-2274 maps to the same legal entity. Karthik, can you publish the two-pager to the shared Drive and send the DocuSign for vendor consent? I'll coordinate the 1:1 with Jordan + Sarah.

Forwarded for visibility — Mina will own communications.

Best,
